## Project

Migration can reduce exposure to climate damage, but access to this adaptation margin is unequal. This project studies how gender-specific constraints on mobility affect occupational adjustment, migration, and welfare as climate risks intensify.

<p class="draft-note">Results are not yet available. For updates on this project, <a href="mailto:t.dobermann@lse.ac.uk">get in touch</a>.</p>
